title: Jesus... I Can't Remember The Last Time I Did Something For Me
topic: no time for himself anymore, everything is for others

bible.text: Come to Me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I gave away my Sunday, my evenings, even my lunch break. Nothing was mine. 😔

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: I saw every piece you handed out. You kept none for yourself.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I feel guilty resting when everyone needs something.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Rest isn't stealing from them. Even I stepped away to rest.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I wouldn't even know what to do with an hour.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Start small. One hour, no phone, no favours. Just sit with Me.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: The world won't fall apart if you rest tonight. I'm holding it.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to the friend who never says no. When did you last rest? 👇
